svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 240 mm of 30 x 4 mm flat bar per bracket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend 90 deg (in a vice, over a 4 mm radius) so the upright leg

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is 88 mm and the outward leg is 143 mm, outside sizes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: three 4.5 mm holes, 6, 22 and 36 mm down from its top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (into a tooth of the low wall comb and its sill).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: at 335 mm each side of the centre line, on a tooth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The manifold sits on the outward leg against the upright; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: brine gutter sits on its outer end, 7 mm further out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the outward leg is square to the wall; both brackets at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the same height within 1 mm (the manifold must not tip).
